results.title: India and Europe accelerate trade ties - Brussels Signal
results.snippet:
The economic figures explain the interest.

According to Eurostat data published by the Council of the EU, merchandise trade between India and the EU-27 reached €118 billion in 2025. Europe imported €69.5 billion worth of Indian goods and exported €48.9 billion, resulting in a trade deficit of €20.6 billion. That made the EU India’s second-largest trading partner in goods, behind the United States

results.title: Pakistan textile exporters warn EU-India trade deal could erode market advantage
results.snippet: The warning comes as the European Union prepares to implement a free trade agreement with India that could reduce Pakistan’s relative tariff advantage under the bloc’s Generalized Scheme of Preferences Plus (GSP+). results.title: Tusk's visit to India: a new opening in the country's relationship with Central and Eastern Europe - New Eastern Europe
results.snippet: Tusk’s visit builds on the strategic partnership established in August 2024 during Narendra Modi’s trip to Warsaw, which produced a mix of concrete and symbolic results. The two sides set a target to double bilateral trade by 2030. It currently stands at about 6 billion dollars.
